Common.name: Dark Magician Girl
Common.desc: Gains 300 ATK for every "Dark Magician" or "Magician of Black Chaos" in the GY.

Common.name: Rogue Doll
Common.desc: A deadly doll gifted with mystical power, it is particularly powerful when attacking against dark forces.

Common.name: Shard of Greed
Common.desc: Each time you draw a card(s) for your normal draw in your Draw Phase, place 1 Greed Counter on this card. You can send this card with 2 or more Greed Counters to the GY; draw 2 cards.

Common.name: Skull Dice
Common.desc: Roll a six-sided die. All monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK/DEF equal to the result x 100, until the end of this turn.

Common.name: Windstorm of Etaqua
Common.desc: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

Super Rare.name: Power Up!
Super Rare.desc:
Activate this Skill during your Main Phase.
Once per Duel, you can make 1 face-up monster on the field gain 500 ATK until the end of this turn.
